items.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022
items.q: John Storyk was the architect and I think it was his first studio by the way too.

ctx.x: Did the room have a distinct sound itself?

I don’t know that it did. I think it allowed for what was recorded in there to sound pleasant and musical. You know you wouldn’t get sounds occurring in another part of the room that weren’t favorable coming in. The room was set up nicely acoustically. John Storyk was the architect and I think it was his first studio by the way too. I think. I may be wrong, but I think so. And anyway so we have a roomful of musicians and you know we have Steve Gadd sitting in, it wasn’t a drum booth but it was like a partition…
And Chick arranged all that music himself?
